title: Phase 6 completed preview DTO boundary cleanup
summary: Migrates completed preview DTO imports from the desktop compatibility export to the existing core DTO inventory owner and removes the matching temporary boundary allowlist rows.
reason: Phase 6 boundary cleanup is reducing remaining core-to-desktop imports in bounded DTO-only slices while preserving completed preview behavior and compatibility exports.
behavior_before: Completed preview facade and policy constructed CompletedPreviewDto through mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto_inventory, producing four allowlisted NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP findings across two import-statement groups.
behavior_after: Completed preview facade and policy construct CompletedPreviewDto from mediapipeline.core.kernel.dto_inventory while the desktop inventory DTO module remains a compatibility export; the completed preview allowlist rows are removed.
manual_validation: PASS: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.check_dependency_boundaries --format json --report-only (hard_findings=58, allowlisted=58, unallowlisted=0, unused_allowlist=0, NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP=41; domains: config=8, processes=9, publish=7, queue=8, schedule=1, status=8)
rollback_plan: Restore CompletedPreviewDto imports in completed facade and policy to mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto_inventory, restore the two removed allowlist rows, refresh the two generated summaries, and mark AB-CMP-004, AB-CMP-005, AB-CMP-013, and AB-CMP-014 open again in the edge ledger.
notes:
